fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: Étude expérimentale évaluant cinq conditions de contexte spectral injecté dans un screener LLM.
fields.quote: We evaluate five conditions that vary the spectral context provided to the LLM screener.

fields.label: Données
fields.quote: While the 8 datasets span different drug classes with varying inclusion rates and sizes, all are within the biomedical domain.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.quote: The main matrix evaluates gpt-5.4-mini across 8 datasets, with a 3-dataset single-seed pilot for gpt-4.1-mini

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: Full-context delivery improves F1 by +0.011 (p=0.008) and WSS@95 by +0.050 (p=0.039).
fields.quote: Full-context delivery yields statistically significant improvements on the two metrics that matter most for screening efficiency: F1 (∆= +0.011, p = 0.008) and WSS@95 (∆= +0.050, p = 0.039).
